verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only the opposite direction: Sprinto sends security questionnaires to vendors and supports AI-assisted review of vendor due diligence. Nothing shows AI drafting answers to inbound customer questionnaires from the organisation's own controls or knowledge base. That outbound vendor-risk workflow is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a sales lead, security questionnaires get answered by AI from my actual controls and knowledge base — drafts I review, not blank spreadsheets I fill
